Messages.Author: wumpus
Messages.Body:
Howdy,

It seems unlikely that this has not been asked before, but my Google-
Fu is insufficient to tracking it down.

Can you use Anarch Convert to make a (non-titled) vampire who is
already an anarch anarch?

I don't see any reason you can't, and we've been playing it as if you
can, but it seemed worth asking. It's an expensive way to clear up
crypt jam on Converts, but it's cheaper than fishing (1 pool and 1
transfer instead of 1 pool and 4 transfers).

Thanks,
Alex

Anarch Convert
Independent. Anarch: When the convert enters play, you may remove him
from the game to make a non-titled vampire you control anarch and
either gain 1 pool or draw a card from your crypt.
